verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents managing multiple companies (entities) under one login. Consolidated multi-entity reporting appears only through a third-party Joiin integration, not as Puzzle's own capability, so consolidation itself gets no credit. missing for 10: native consolidated financial statements across entities, intercompany eliminations, detailed multi-entity management docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can manage multiple legal entities and produce consolidated financials across them

citations.quote: Puzzle supports managing multiple companies (entities) under one login.
